# Mahmud Abdulmalik (Furyengi) — Technical Profile

Mahmud Abdulmalik, known online as Furyengi, is a full-stack engineer based in Ilorin, Nigeria. His work centers on secure backend services, cloud-ready infrastructure, developer tooling, CI/CD systems, and practical products with clear operational behavior.

## Experience

### Orvel — Creator & Lead Engineer (2026–present)
Designs and builds a local-first platform for creating, teaching, evaluating, and running AI agents across local and hosted model providers.

### Prismor — AI Security Engineer (2026–present)
Contributed a focused improvement to authentication failure handling across buffered and streaming AI responses, with automated coverage for proxy error paths and clearer local-backend integration guidance.

### Galen Africa — App Developer / Team Lead (2025–present)
Leads development of GalenDesk across application architecture, database workflows, backend integrations, product direction, and reliability.

### Afrigenomed — Backend Developer (2024–2026)
Built Node.js backend logic for users, content, and learning workflows in a learning-management system.

## Core technologies
Python, FastAPI, Django, Node.js, Express, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Redis, SQLAlchemy, Celery, Supabase, Docker, GitHub Actions, Google Cloud, Cloudflare Tunnel, Linux, React, Next.js, React Native, Expo, and Electron.

## Projects

### Prismor
Improved an AI-security proxy so callers can distinguish upstream provider authentication failures from policy refusals across buffered and streaming responses. Added automated tests and local OpenAI-compatible backend guidance.

### Scalable API Platform
Production-oriented task API with JWT authentication, asynchronous data access, caching, background jobs, migrations, containerized environments, and CI.

### RunXR
Self-hosted CI/CD platform with GitHub OAuth, signed webhooks, persistent build jobs, live logs, and an isolated Docker-first runner.

### Evnar
Self-hosted secrets manager based on encrypted storage, multiple environments, and a CLI-first workflow.

### GalenDesk
Offline-first pharmacy inventory and point-of-sale application with transactional FEFO stock deduction, batch tracking, and expiry alerts.

### Webhook Billing and Notifications
Webhook-driven backend with HMAC signature verification, idempotent event processing, subscription-state synchronization, and queued notifications.

## Blog

### Building Orvel: What "Training Your Own AI" Actually Means
Explains training as a practical product surface for Orvel: shaping memory, tools, corrections, documents, feedback, evaluation, and model portability instead of only training a foundation model from scratch.
